bio.text: Heather Baxter, of Rapid City, is the Republican candidate for South Dakota secretary of state in 2026.
Baxter is a small-business owner who served two years in the state House of Representatives, representing District 34 in Pennington County.
Baxter won the Republican nomination by defeating incumbent Secretary of State Monae Johnson in a vote of delegates at the state party convention.

sources.title: State Rep announces candidacy for South Dakota Secretary of State
